mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever found yourself wondering about the story behind the food on your plate? Sometimes, the simplest questions spark the biggest adventures—like asking, “Is goat really beef?” Together, we’re about to step into a world where culinary traditions, language, and farming practices all come together in surprising ways. Inspired by Jeffery M. Camp’s thought-provoking book, Is Goat Beef?, we’ll dive into the subtle yet fascinating differences that shape the meats we eat, and the reasons we call them what we do. As we explore the unique paths of goat and beef from pasture to plate, we’ll uncover the hidden stories in farming history, the cultural twists in food language, and the global habits that influence what ends up on our tables. This isn’t just about definitions—it’s about discovering how our choices, beliefs, and even the words we use reflect much bigger ideas about nutrition, sustainability, and tradition. So, welcome to this journey. Let’s get curious together, and see what unfolds when we look a little closer at the foods we thought we already knew.
